Ruth Kim: Quick flag - billing shows an undercount for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-02 (~11.3k tokens). Looks like a backfill job ran late and got partially applied.

Ethan Cole: Can you paste the diagnostic SQL?

Ruth Kim: Sure:
```sql
SELECT org_id, SUM(tokens_expected)-SUM(tokens_ingested) AS gap
FROM token_ingest_summary
WHERE day BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-02'
GROUP BY org_id
HAVING gap > 0;
```

metering-bot: alert: backfill-late-detected job=backfill-20260901 backlog=14h

Maya Chen: I'll own customer comms and billing coordination. Need exact before/after counts per org to prepare credits.

Ethan Cole: I'll run a dry-run replay and then the real replay if dry-run matches. Dry-run cmd:
```bash
./backfill-run --job backfill-20260901 --dry-run --detect-missing
```
Dry-run projects events_to_replay=11320 projected_gap=11300.

Ruth Kim: Sanitized org gaps: org-329=6400, org-610=4900 (~11.3k).

Ethan Cole: Starting real backfill now. job-id=backfill-1157. Will post ledger backfill job id and sample verification.

billing-bot: INFO: invoice-reissue paused for affected invoices (hold-id=inv-hold-2098).

Ethan Cole: Backfill complete. ledger-backfill job-id=ledger-backfill-4120. Verification file uploaded: https://redwood.internal/repairs/ledger-backfill-4120.csv

Maya Chen: Draft customer note: "We identified a delayed processing window that underreported your usage for Sep 1-2. We've corrected your ledger and issued a credit of $X. Apologies for the inconvenience." Legal prefers "delayed processing" phrasing and USD credits.

billing-bot: INFO: invoice-reissue inv-hold-2098 resumed and completed. credits_applied=true.

Ruth Kim: Postmortem owner: Ethan Cole. Action items: persist backfill run ids in ledger, add a daily ledger parity check, and lower backfill-late alert threshold to 6h. Draft due 2026-09-07.

Ethan Cole: Will publish postmortem and add tickets for persistence and alerts. Closing finance follow-up once postmortem link posted here.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
